source(output(
		RECEIPTREASON as string,
		RECEIPTREASONCD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select DISTINCT TRIM(rs.mctr_desc)  as ReceiptReason, rs.MCTR_VALUE as ReceiptReasonCd FROM CMC_MCTR_CD_TRANS RS WHERE RS.MCTR_ENTITY = \'RCPT\' AND  RS.MCTR_TYPE = \'RSN\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		ReceiptReasonId as integer,
		ReceiptReasonCd as string,
		ReceiptReason as string,
		ReceiptReasonDesc as string,
		IsValid as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Receipts.ReceiptReason',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@RECEIPTREASONCD == LookupLKPTABLE@ReceiptReasonCd,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		RECEIPTREASON as string,
		ReceiptReasonCd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		RECEIPTREASON = Param_0,
		ReceiptReasonCd = Param_1)) ~> OLEDBCommand
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		ReceiptReasonCd as string,
		ReceiptReason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ReceiptReasonCd = RECEIPTREASONCD,
		ReceiptReason = RECEIPTREASON)) ~> SQLSTAGERECEIPTREASON
